summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is highly diverse, spanning open-source hubs, serverless inference APIs, and enterprise cloud platforms. Hugging Face remains the dominant open-source hub with over 2 million models, though the ecosystem is concentrated with the top 200 models comprising 49.6% of all downloads. Alternatives like Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and cloud platforms like AWS Bedrock serve distinct niches from hobbyist prototyping to enterprise-scale deployment.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The leading open-source AI model repository and collaboration hub, hosting models, datasets, and Spaces for running demos and applications.
platforms.pricing: Free tier available; Pro plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference API and dedicated endpoints billed separately by compute usage.
features: Hosts over 2 million models including Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Qwen families
476 million cumulative Llama downloads recorded by March 2026
DeepSeek surpassed Mistral in cumulative downloads in January 2026 (128.2M vs 124.3M)
Spaces for hosting interactive ML demos and applications
Datasets and model cards with versioning and community discussions
Inference API and dedicated inference endpoints
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain capabilities
Enterprise SSO, audit logs, and private model hosting
Transformers, Diffusers, and PEFT library integrations
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and enterprises seeking the largest selection of open-weight models with strong community collaboration and reproducibility.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local LLM runtime that allows users to download and run open-source language models entirely on their own hardware without internet connectivity.
platforms.model_count: 300+ curated models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, and more)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; costs limited to local hardware only.
features: Offline and fully local inference with no data leaving the user's machine
Simple CLI and REST API for integrating models into applications
Support for GPU acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Silicon Metal)
Compatible with OpenAI API format for easy migration
Supports multimodal models including vision-capable variants
Active community library of Modelfiles for custom configurations
Integrates with Open WebUI and LangChain for richer interfaces
Cross-platform: macOS, Linux, and Windows support
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, hobbyists, and enterprises that require fully air-gapped or on-premise LLM deployments at zero inference cost.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform offering a simple pay-per-second API to run thousands of open-source AI models without managing infrastructure.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second based on compute used; no upfront costs. Pricing varies by hardware tier (e.g., Nvidia T4 to A100). Free credits available for new users.
features: 50,000+ open-source models accessible via a unified API
Supports image generation, language, audio, and video models
One-line Python and Node.js client libraries
Ability to publish and monetize custom models
Automatic scaling with no infrastructure management
Webhooks for asynchronous prediction workflows
Model versioning and reproducibility built-in
OpenAI-compatible endpoints for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who want the simplest possible API access to a wide variety of open-source models without DevOps overhead, especially for image and multimedia AI tasks.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance cloud inference and fine-tuning platform offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for open-source LLMs at competitive pricing.
platforms.model_count: 100+ leading open-source models including Llama, Mixtral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and DBRX
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference; among the lowest-cost LLM inference providers. Example: Llama 3.1 8B at approximately $0.18 per million tokens. Fine-tuning billed separately per compute hour.
features: OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy migration from proprietary models
Serverless and dedicated inference deployment options
Custom fine-tuning with LoRA and full fine-tuning support
Flash Attention and other inference optimizations for low latency
Supports long-context models and function calling
Enterprise SLAs and private deployments available
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tooling integrations
Active research division publishing open models and benchmarks
platforms.best_for: Cost-conscious developers and enterprises running high-volume LLM inference workloads who need OpenAI API compatibility with open-source model flexibility.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A fast and cost-efficient serverless inference platform for open-source LLMs and image models, optimized for production-grade latency and throughput.
platforms.model_count: 50+ curated production-ready models including Llama, Mixtral, DeepSeek, Stable Diffusion, and SDXL variants
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token and pay-per-image; competitive low-cost pricing. Free tier available for prototyping. Volume discounts for enterprise.
features: Industry-leading inference speed with FireAttention optimization engine
OpenAI-compatible chat completions and embeddings API
Supports function calling, JSON mode, and structured outputs
Image generation API with Stable Diffusion and FLUX models
On-demand and reserved capacity deployment options
Fine-tuned model hosting and deployment
Low-latency streaming responses
SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise security
platforms.best_for: Production AI applications requiring the lowest latency open-source LLM inference, particularly teams building real-time user-facing products with high throughput demands.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: A fully managed enterprise cloud service providing access to foundation models from multiple leading AI providers through a unified AWS API, integrated with the broader AWS ecosystem.
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Mistral, Stability AI, Amazon Titan, Cohere, and AI21 Labs
platforms.pricing: On-demand pay-per-token pricing per model; Provisioned Throughput available for consistent workloads with hourly billing. Prices vary significantly by model and modality.
features: Access to Claude, Llama, Mistral, Titan, Cohere, and more through one API
Native integration with AWS services: S3, Lambda, SageMaker, and IAM
Agents for Bedrock: multi-step autonomous task execution with tool use
Knowledge Bases for fully managed RAG with vector store integration
Model evaluation and guardrails for responsible AI and content filtering
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training on proprietary data
Private model deployment with VPC isolation and no data sharing with model providers
Enterprise compliance: HIPAA, SOC, ISO, FedRAMP, and GDPR ready
platforms.best_for: Enterprise and regulated-industry teams already embedded in the AWS ecosystem that need managed, compliant, multi-provider model access with deep cloud service integrations and strong governance controls.
